examples.trans: I need to calmly figure myself out.

meanings.en: to cool down, get cold (of food, drink, or anger)
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cool down, go cold', paired with 'остывать'.

related.gloss: not to to cool down (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Ешьте быстрее, пока всё не остыло.
examples.trans: Eat faster before everything gets cold.

examples.text: Завтрак ещё не остыл.
examples.trans: Breakfast hasn't gone cold yet.

examples.text: Пей чай, пока он не остыл.
examples.trans: Drink your tea before it gets cold.
